meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 DuckDB、Polars 等常驻内核引擎处理你的数据文件,完成 CSV/parquet/JSON 的查询、分组、join、聚合、时间序列、清洗与绘图,并对重活报告行数和耗时。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、parquet 或 JSON 数据集,做分组、join、聚合等 SQL 或 DataFrame 类操作,以及时间序列、清洗、绘图时触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude analyzes your data files using DuckDB and Polars resident kernels plus one-shot tools: CSV/parquet/JSON queries, group-by, joins, aggregation, time series, cleaning and charts, reporting row counts and timing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for analysis of a CSV, parquet or JSON dataset: group-by, joins, aggregations, time series, distributions, cleaning or plotting.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV: total order value grouped by city
